gen-vast-shadow-gf-hind-siliguri: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke at a single width, with a tall mean line and generous side space. Hind Siliguri hums along as a flat gray sans, its rounds gapping open, so paragraphs slide past without friction.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hind-vadodara: Vast Shadow is vintage and eye-catching, with a tall mean line. Hind Vadodara keeps its sans-serif letters spacious and uniform in thickness, so the loud heading above has room to be loud.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-huninn: Eye-catching and vintage, Vast Shadow cuts each stroke at a single width and leaves generous space between letters. Huninn, a sans-serif with lowercase rising close to cap height, supplies the modern steadiness that makes the showy heading usable.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-inter-tight: A tall mean line and uniform strokes mark Vast Shadow at a glance. Inter Tight then slips in as a modern sans, its short ascenders and held-back curve tails keeping text compact under the display lettering.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-karla: Vast Shadow draws wire-like letters of uniform thickness under a tall mean line, giving the heading a vintage, eye-catching look. Karla, stocky and tall in the middle, can take a slightly smaller size.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri lifts its x-height skyward and keeps its rounded letters open and inviting. Kedebideri meets the bent-tubing letters of Vast Shadow, all one gauge, with a welcome that lets them stand out.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-khula: Khula, a modern sans with a tall midsection and open-mouthed curves, sits under Vast Shadow, whose w is uniform throughout. Paragraphs in it flow easily, never tiring the eye.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-krub: Krub brings a pronounced x-height and pen-lifted curves that leave loops unfinished, a contemporary sans under a vintage heading. Vast Shadow grabs the eye with its full bowls; Krub carries the reading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-kufam: Vintage and eye-catching, Vast Shadow keeps every stroke uniform. Kufam, a contemporary sans, wears a single neon-tube track width and open curves in e, so its bodies fill the line beneath the heading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-lexend-deca: Vintage flair with a tall mean line: that is Vast Shadow. Lexend Deca, a sans-serif with unshaded lines and small-looking capitals beside big lowercase, gives it a clean, approachable partner.
